name: 🍖 Sizzling Simulator 🍖
desc:
🙀 Use the code "CAT" and LIKE the game for a FREE PET!

Welcome to Sizzling Simulator! Hunt animals with 🗡️ weapons to collect 🍖 meat to sizzle to gain ⭐ experience to level up! Open eggs to unlock rare pets that can be leveled up and evolved! 🐶 Pets help you hunt and level up!

🍖 Grill Time continues while you are offline!

💳 Premium Members get a free 🐻 Teddy Bear pet upon joining!
